epic.name: Overview and yield curve charts
unverifiedAssumptions: Verify the two headline rate cards fill in once rates are imported: the app assumes the overview's key rates can be told apart by their family (nominal vs inflation), spot type and a "10Y" tenor label. If the service names them differently, both cards will keep saying "No data" even though rates exist.

Verify the size of the daily change: the app assumes the service already sends the change in basis points. If it actually sends a percentage difference, a real move of a few basis points will show as something like "+0.0 bp".

Verify Across families shows four lines: the app assumes the curve list has exactly one Nominal, Real, Inflation and OIS curve for each rate type and segment. If OIS has no long-end forward curve, or the families are labelled differently, lines will be missing and wrongly reported as "No data has been imported".

Check the Overview chart when no spot curves exist: the card shows only its title and the empty message, without the "Nominal, real and implied inflation, long end" subtitle. Confirm that is what you want.
Check the spot chart's rate axis range: it is chosen automatically (0.000 to 8.000 with the sample data). Confirm that range reads well, or whether it should fit closer to the data.
Check Yield curves with Compare with cleared: the chart subtitle shows just the valuation date (e.g. "2026-09-30"). Confirm a bare date is the right subtitle for a single-date chart.
Check the Compare with calendar: its button is labelled "Choose comparison date", and the "Dates with data" line appears only under Valuation date. Confirm that is acceptable.

Check Across families when more than one family has no data: the subtitle lists them with "or" (e.g. "No data has been imported for UK OIS spot curve or UK implied real spot curve on 2026-10-02."). Confirm that wording.
Check Across families when none of the four families has data on the chosen date: the chart shows only the missing-data line, with no axes or legend. Confirm that is right.

manualTestResults.test: Overview spot curves chart shows an OIS curve
manualTestResults.comment: The Spot curves on latest valuation date chart does not show an OIS curve even though the API now returns it
